source: Two follow-up user instructions in this coordinator chat
instructions: do all the actual fixing of the LSP in work with the cleanup happening in an intermediate branch for LSP release
irules performance we can ignore for this release, if tcl is working well enough irules is highly likely to be good

functional_fix_location.choice: All functional LSP fixes on work
functional_fix_location.meaning: Use the intermediate release branch for cleanup/extraction/validation only. If validation finds a functional defect, fix it on work, validate it there and carry the reviewed fix to the candidate.

irules_performance_release_gate.choice: No dedicated iRules performance requirement for this LSP release
irules_performance_release_gate.meaning: Focus release performance acceptance on Tcl corpus and relevant supported Tcl/SpecTcl workloads. iRules correctness, safety and applicable BIGIP/LSP repository checks remain required; this is no measured claim of iRules performance equivalence.
